### Boasting About the Future
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/boasting-about-future
Passage: Proverbs 27:1
Points:
- God alone possesses complete and exhaustive knowledge of what tomorrow will bring.
- Human beings are called to humility rather than presumptuous boasting about future plans.
- While thoughtful preparation is good, success depends entirely on the sovereign will of God.
- Remembering that God holds the future keeps our expectations and disappointments in proper perspective.

### I Got My First Stone
Author: Jennifer Rothschild
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-7-2010-11632755.html
Passage: Proverbs 27:9
Points:
- Meaningful friendships provide sweet counsel that enriches both spiritual and daily life.
- Believers grow through mutual encouragement across different generations and life stages.
- If we desire wise and caring friends, we should intentionally become that kind of friend to others.
- Jesus remains our ultimate, steadfast friend who never abandons or forsakes us.
